additional_mechanism: Concrete-token diagnostics strip existing _CONTEXT_ONLY plus take bring still along continue need know tell explain please say mean walk ride park onto around. Weight current concrete tokens and deduplicate clean inherited context. If no concrete current token survives, preserve full inherited query.
current_match_gate_mechanism: Isolated copied retrieval function, no production edit: BM25 ranks include only passages containing any concrete latest token when one exists. Keyword query retains deduplicated inherited tokens. Variants compare no boost with one additional copy of concrete latest terms. Dense ranks, full query/vector, RRF and cap stay unchanged. Generic follow-ups have an empty gate and retain all context.
owned_anchor_mechanism: Bounded diagnostic: retain current normalized deduplicated words and my/our noun phrases cut at common prepositions/verbs when concrete current tokens exist. Generic follow-ups or cases without an owned phrase retain the full query. No boost or rank change.

recommendation.mechanism: Retain deduplicated latest and inherited lexical tokens. When latest has concrete tokens, filter the BM25 branch to passages matching any of those current tokens. Keep the full-history dense query and all dense ranks unchanged; generic follow-ups retain unfiltered context. No additional retriever, reranker, weighting threshold, or final-selection lane.
recommendation.why: Fixed query-token weighting and the owned-subject anchor can put the leash passage first in BM25 while still dropping it from the five fused results. Old-topic passages receive a second RRF contribution for very weak lexical overlap. Filtering history-only lexical matches removes that contribution while dense search continues to retrieve broad context.
limits: Diagnostic eligibility initially filtered the top-40 BM25 list. Production applies it before the fetch cap; this was compared using the exact cached vectors and preserves target ranks 2 and 1.
Lexical matching needs current-word normalization; semantic paraphrases may only be found by the unchanged dense branch.
Only the two saved actual follow-up vectors were available for exact hybrid comparison; synthetic generic follow-ups used BM25 only.
No generation or claim review was run, so these are retrieval diagnostics rather than answer accuracy results.

implementation_note: Current-match eligibility is applied before the top-40 BM25 fetch cap, avoiding loss of matching passages below that cap. Exact cached hybrid target ranks match the post-cap diagnostic: H01.3 rank 2, H05.3 rank 1.
artifact_detail: Final-passage details retained for original candidate2, recommended gate, rejected owned anchor, and implemented gate. Other variants retain keyword query and rank outcomes.
